page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192-lssd is a high-capacity server instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 1488.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory allocation of 7.75 GB per core.

This server configuration includes a substantial local storage array consisting of 32 local NVMe SSDs, totaling 12885 GB of local storage capacity. It does not include any GPU hardware, making it a CPU-only resource. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

Given its high memory density and extensive local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads and large-scale database operations. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density resource allocation, balancing massive memory capacity and local storage performance against a dedicated CPU architecture. It is suitable for large databases, memory-intensive data processing, and enterprise applications requiring high local disk throughput.
